title: Oh Baby a Triple
blurb: "Oh baby, a triple!" — hollered in an old Wii bowling advert by a man whose enthusiasm exceeds the situation by several orders of magnitude. The internet extracted the line, looped it, and installed it as the standard reaction to three of anything at all. It is the purest possible form of meme: a stranger's completely genuine excitement, permanently detached from whatever caused it. Deploy it whenever something happens for the third time, however trivial.
origin: A line from a Nintendo Wii bowling advert, extracted into meme use.
